'''2007 Endor Regionals Mike French DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike French]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V) (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth)|OVS4-40-Imperial_Occupation-remaster.webp|label=Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael French
* '''Deck name:''' Reid Smith Builds Good Decks
* '''Username:''' mike french
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
